description: This file contains unit tests for the HolidayService class in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It defines multiple test methods to validate functionalities like getting/setting DAO, saving holidays, and searching holidays with various filters, including handling of recurring holidays over different date ranges. The tests use mock objects and load test data to verify expected behaviors and outputs.

classes.name: HolidayServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing HolidayService functionalities in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, including configuration paths, mock caches, and the HolidayService instance.

methods.name: testGetSetHolidayDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getter for HolidayDao returns an instance of HolidayDao.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving a Holiday entity via the HolidayService with a mocked DAO.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysNoneRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching for non-recurring holidays within a date range.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests searching for holidays with recurring pattern in the current year.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringOtherYear
methods.description: Tests searching for recurring holidays across different years.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringMultiYear
methods.description: Tests searching for multiple recurring holidays spanning several years.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysPartYear
methods.description: Tests filtering holidays within a partial year range.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysCheckUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures that search results are unique and correctly filtered, including offset and limit handling.

methods.name: compareHolidays
methods.description: Helper method that asserts the expected list of Holiday objects matches the actual list.

methods.name: compareHoliday
methods.description: Helper method that compares individual Holiday objects for equality.
